# Tools of the CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml), each pinned to an exact version: a new release (or a compromised one)
# never runs in the CI before a pull request of Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) updates it here. The dev venv
# (./init_dev_venv.sh) installs them too (.github/requirements-dev.txt).
# Every version must support Python 3.10 to 3.14 (the matrix of the tests). pip itself is not here: the CI and the dev
# venv upgrade it to its latest release before installing these tools.
#
# The package itself is installed without build isolation (pip install --no-build-isolation, python -m build
# --no-isolation): its build backend is the hatchling pinned here, not the latest release.

# lint and tests
flake8==7.4.1
pytest==9.1.1
# type check (types-pyserial: type stubs of pyserial, for the gateways of pyModbusTCP.tools)
mypy==2.4.0
types-pyserial==3.5.0.20260712
# build of the two packages (build backend: hatchling, as required by both pyproject.toml)
build==1.6.1
hatchling==1.32.4
# serial line of the gateways (extra serial: pyserial>=3.5,<4)
pyserial==3.5
